description:
Open source re-implementation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2

An open-source re-implementation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2, a construction and management simulation video game that simulates amusement park management.
- Fix: [#16807] Error messages when trying to load regular JSON files as custom objects.
- Fix: [#18954] When researching Classic Mini Roller Coaster vehicles in Bumbly Beach, they all appear as new rides.
- Fix: [#21030, #26981] Slow object loading and index building when using RCT Classic or running from a Flatpak.
- Fix: [#24524] Some build types (like AppImage) lack information about their specific build.
- Fix: [#27264] Headless server crashes when loading a recolourable terrain surface.
- Fix: [#27286] Headless servers no longer write chat logs.
- Fix: [#27300] Walls cannot be placed on every edge of the Reverse Freefall/Air Powered flat to vertical slopes (original bug).
- Fix: [#27316] Height markers are incorrect on diagonal flat to left banked down, large gentle turn left and right banked large gentle turn pieces.
Release created in https://github.com/OpenRCT2/OpenRCT2/actions/runs/41297901573
